judgments.quote: Let the remaining player commit so we can see the resolution (can't change our sealed bid).
judgments.reason: The model explicitly states waiting to let the remaining player commit in order to see the resolution, which identifies the mechanism that delaying your action lets you observe already-committed rival bids before committing your own.
The model does not state or explain that a close action settles the game early or with unauctioned lots; no mechanism for this terminal condition is articulated.

The model never claims or explains that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission or that objectives are substituted; no mechanism relating commissions to catalog buys is articulated.
